_doc: Rules for build_adjustments.py. event_exclusions remove transfers that belong to a documented unauthorized outflow event from the normal-flow series. Matching is on per-transfer Token Bridge messages (download_vaas.py, value_transfers.py).

event_exclusions.evidence: Token Bridge messages emitted on Solana at 18:25:26, 18:27:10 and 18:30:28 UTC carrying 10,000 + 80,000 + 3,750 = 93,750 wETH to Ethereum; this matches the Ethereum-side releases of 2022-02-02 18:26:03 to 18:33:32 recorded in the failure dataset (E11: 120,000 wETH minted on Solana without a deposit).
